'''Ndunda''' is a minor [[Mambiloid language]] of [[Nigeria]]. It was discovered by [[Roger Blench]] near the [[Mvanip language|Mvanip]]-speaking town of Zongo Ajiya. Ndunda village is situated about 5 kilometers from Yerimaru, to the south of Zongo Ajiya. It is closely related to but distinct from [[Mvanip language|Mvanip]].<ref name="BlenchAtlas4">{{Cite book|title=An Atlas of Nigerian Languages|last=Blench|first=Roger|publisher=Kay Williamson Educational Foundation|year=2019|edition=4th|location=Cambridge}}</ref>
